data.description: Executive Beachfront Living w/ Panoramic Sea Views
data.long_description:
Experience elevated beachfront living in this stunning 2-bedroom apartment at The One JBR, one of the most prestigious residential addresses in Jumeirah Beach Residence. Spanning 1,940 sqft, this beautifully designed residence offers spacious interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and breathtaking sea and skyline views that create a luxurious yet relaxing atmosphere.

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area, a modern fully fitted kitchen with premium finishes, generously sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, and elegant bathrooms crafted with high-end materials. The master suite offers exceptional privacy along with panoramic waterfront views, making it the perfect retreat after a long day.

Located in the heart of JBR, residents enjoy direct access to the beach, world-class dining, luxury retail outlets, and vibrant entertainment destinations. This property is ideal for families and professionals seeking a premium lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most iconic waterfront communities.
